collectionMethod: Contributor's own Kimi Code CLI session on a legacy Kimi membership CNY 199 (Allegretto) account, model alias kimi-code/k3.1-pro-highspeed with thinking effort high, provider managed:kimi-code (direct Kimi Code OAuth, no gateway or proxy). Token counts were summed offline from the client's local session event log (one usage record per LLM request, fields inputOther / output / inputCacheRead / inputCacheCreation) across the main agent and five sub-agents. The membership dashboard percentage before and after the run was not captured, so no weekly or monthly allowance is back-calculated here. Official model-page wording was read on 2026-10-24. Research-only — no adopted row generated and no adopted value changed.
sources: Contributor local Kimi Code CLI session log (private; aggregates only, see PUBLICATION.md)
data/research/goat-kimi-k31-pro-round1-2026-10-24.json (third-party catalog three-part price for Kimi K3.1 Pro, cross-reference only)
scope: One Kimi Code session of about 22 minutes: a multi-agent MR-drafting task on a Rust repository (plan mode, two explore sub-agents, two coder sub-agents, one more explore sub-agent, Postgres-backed acceptance test run). Consumption sample for the model identifier k3.1-pro-highspeed on the legacy CNY 199 tier. No quota percentage, so this is not an allowance measurement under CONVENTIONS.md §3.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted. adopted.csv has no kimi_allegretto_cn × kimi-k3.1-pro or × kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed row; DECISIONS.md still says HighSpeed has no adoptable value. This file adds a first-party availability and consumption data point, not an allowance.

target.plan: Kimi 会员 199 / Allegretto (CN, legacy plan)
target.client: Kimi Code CLI, multi-agent (main + 5 sub-agents, all bound to the same model alias and effort)
target.requiredEvidenceForAllowance: Same account, same model, total tokens plus a 7-day or monthly dashboard percentage at the start and end of the window — not captured in this run.

tokenShares.note: Lower cache share than the repository standard workload (97 / 2.5 / 0.5) because each of the five sub-agents starts a fresh context and the main agent's 94 requests re-read a 100k+ token context. Output share 0.55% is in line with the standard 0.5%.

contextPerRequest.note: No request exceeded the 262,144-token boundary, so this sample does not exercise the 1M-context entitlement.

observed.cacheCreationNote: The client log reports inputCacheCreation = 0 on every request. Kimi's API bills cache writes separately for the K3 series, so either the Kimi Code channel does not expose cache-write counts to the client or they are folded into other fields. Treat the uncached-input figure as 'not cache-hit input', not as a verified cache-write count.

rateLimit.message: 429 The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later
rateLimit.note: Capacity overload, not a quota exhaustion message; the client retried after ~0.5 s and the turn completed. No quota-limit message appeared in the session.

observed.dashboardQuotaNote: Not captured. Without a before/after 5-hour, 7-day or monthly percentage no weekly or monthly token allowance can be inferred from this sample.

k3.1-pro-highspeed.consumptionQuote: 高速版（约 2–3 倍速，2 倍消耗）; 消耗约为普速版两倍
k3.1-pro-highspeed.tiers: Pro and above (new plans) / Allegretto and above (legacy plans)

k3.1-pro.tiers: Plus and above / Moderato and above; 1M context needs Pro and above / Allegretto and above

officialModelPage.consistencyWithThisRun: The legacy CNY 199 Allegretto account could call k3.1-pro-highspeed for the whole session, matching the page's 'Allegretto and above' entitlement.
officialModelPage.implicationIfAdopted: If the maintainer later adopts a kimi_allegretto_cn × kimi-k3.1-pro allowance, the highspeed variant's raw-token allowance should be derived as one half of it (official 2× credit consumption), the same way the official k3 (1M) = 2 × k3-256k and K2.7 Code Highspeed = 3× multipliers are handled, rather than measured separately.

kimiK31ProThirdPartyThreePartPriceUsd.note: Not Moonshot's official API price. The official pricing page (platform.kimi.com/docs/pricing/chat) renders its tables client-side and was not captured on 2026-10-24. Recorded only so a future list-worth conversion of this sample has a documented candidate price; no list-worth is computed here.

calculation.note: Deliberately not computed: no dashboard percentage. Multiplying the CNY 199 adopted K3 allowance (14.51亿, K3-256K-dominated mixed sample) by any K3.1 ratio would be a cross-model assumption with no evidence in this file.

whatWouldUpgradeThisSample: A Kimi membership page screenshot (5-hour, 7-day and monthly usage percentages) taken immediately before and after a k3.1-pro-highspeed-only session on the same account, with the client token total for the same interval.
Repeating the run with k3.1-pro (standard speed) under the same account to check the official 2× consumption ratio against dashboard deltas.
Capturing whether the Kimi Code channel reports cache-write tokens anywhere, so the input split can be reconciled with Moonshot's K3-series cache-write billing.
confidence: n/a for allowance (no percentage); token counts themselves are exact client-log sums
redaction: Session identifiers, prompts, repository paths and account details are omitted; only aggregate token counts, timestamps rounded to the second, request counts and the single error message are published.
